blockers.selection: Collapse the selection first: the wizard inserts at the cursor and will not replace selected text.
blockers.not-body-text: Place the cursor in the main text, not in a table, frame, header, footer or note.
blockers.tracked-changes: The document has tracked changes or recording is on. Accept/reject them and turn recording off first.
blockers.unsupported-selection: Select a single range of text.
blockers.multiple-selections: Multiple selections are not supported. Select one range.
blockers.no-selection: Select the text to convert first.
blockers.protected-section: The selection is inside a protected section.
blockers.content-changed: The selection changed since the preview. Run the command again.
blockers.outside-sheet: The data does not fit inside the sheet from this cell.

csvErrors.too-large: File is larger than the allowed size.
csvErrors.invalid-utf8: The file is not valid UTF-8 (nothing was imported). Re-save it as UTF-8.
csvErrors.unsupported-encoding: UTF-16 files are not supported. Re-save as UTF-8.
csvErrors.cell-too-long: A cell is longer than 32767 characters.

nd30.title: Administrative document (ND30)
nd30.signerAuthority:
Signing authority
(TM., KT., Q., TL., TUQ.)
nd30.applyPage: Apply A4 and ND30 margins to the current page style (not part of Undo)
nd30.pageNumbers: Page numbers, hidden on page 1 (clears the Undo history)
nd30.legal: Presentation helper only; legal validity is not checked. Empty fields become [placeholders].
nd30.inserted: Document inserted. Use Undo (Ctrl+Z) to remove it in one step.
nd30.headerSkipped: Page numbers were not added because the page style already has a header.
nd30.fontMissing: Font "%s" is not installed on this computer; a substitute font will be displayed. Install it for exact ND30 appearance.
nd30.numberHelp: Document number, digits only (numbers below 10 get a leading zero)
nd30.symbolHelp: Document symbol, e.g. QĐ-UBND (no spaces or /)

convert.title: Convert legacy Vietnamese text to Unicode
convert.noSuggest: No reliable suggestion: choose the encoding yourself.
convert.unicodeSkipped: %d run(s) already contain Unicode Vietnamese and are left unchanged.
convert.summary: %d letter(s) converted, %d unmapped byte(s) kept, %d field/other portion(s) skipped.
convert.done: Converted %d run(s). Undo (Ctrl+Z) restores text and formatting in one step.
convert.nothing: Nothing to convert in this selection.

sheet.formatted: Format applied. Values and formulas are unchanged.
sheet.textCells: %d cell(s) hold text; text is not converted, only numbers and dates are formatted.

csv.overwrite: The destination is not empty. Overwrite?
csv.imported: Imported %d cell(s) at %s. Undo (Ctrl+Z) removes them in one step.

welcome.title: Welcome to HST Office
welcome.heading: Welcome to HST Office!
welcome.oneLiner: An office suite for Vietnamese users: works offline, no account, no data collection.
features: Vietnamese user interface with a Vietnamese spelling dictionary.
Administrative documents formatted per Decree 30/2020/ND-CP (HST menu → Administrative document).
Convert legacy TCVN3 (ABC) or VNI text to Unicode with one command.
Open and save Word, Excel and PowerPoint files (.docx, .xlsx, .pptx).
welcome.helpTip: Tip: press F1 at any time to open the user guide (no Internet needed).
